What failed is one layer below and predates this stone: the embed host refuses the rendering. MEASURED — nomic-embed-text carries nomic-bert.context_length=2048; a binary search over this exact content accepted 7403 chars and refused at 7447; the rendering is 11283 chars; the sibling verdict that landed earlier today was 6772 chars and is the largest node in the hypothesize tree, so this ceiling had never been touched before. Law 7 held exactly as designed across all seven entries: the enqueued line stands, pending() still derives it, the ledger is byte-unchanged at 187 bytes, every door named the failure loudly on stderr and in its payload, and every verb still served. So: criterion 3 (the loop closes in anger) FAILS on its second half, and hypothesis 5 is KILLED by its own named falsifier ('the real drain fails on the real artifact'). Bounding a rendering against an embed context is a fresh design question touching every deposit face in chart and librarian; it is not in these berths and a builder may not settle it mid-close. Kicked back to the orchestrator with the diagnostic whole.
